feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 19 November 2026 4:45am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 19 November 2026 at 4:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong Winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the west of Ireland, bringing complex frontal zones across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

East or northeast 4 to 6, but occasionally 7 in the north at first, decreasing 4 or 5 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate this afternoon but remaining slight towards the English coast.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or showers, clearing to become mainly fair later today.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast 4 or 5, decreasing northeast 3 or 4 Friday morning, then backing northerly 2 or 3 in the afternoon, becoming variable later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate at first.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
